title: feat(studio): the Form tab becomes Field layout, edits field groups only, and arranges an installed object into its .custom pair
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB9qsP28anD5tWRUHq8j1xSU)_

Fixes #36505

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 管理员在 Studio 对象页看到的「表单」页签改名为「字段布局」，并多一句说明：这里的分组和顺序用在记录页、右侧预览、新建和编辑弹窗上；已安装应用的对象（比如 HotCRM 的线索）从只读变为可以调整分组和顺序，每个字段标出来自原始包、其他包还是本环境。
- 属于「客户可在已安装应用上自定义」这条主线：之前没有任何界面能调整已安装对象的字段分组。
- 出错时管理员看到的是分组顺序不对或保存被拒；改动只写进本环境的定制包，原始包不动，把定制包里的分组设置删掉就恢复原样。
- 无。

## What changes

**The tab (items 1, 4).** Studio's object page tab 「表单」 / `Form` reads 「字段布局」 / `Field layout` (same key `engine.studio.data.tab.form`, value only). The 「字段分组」 source chip beside the Layout/Preview switch is replaced by one sentence (`engine.studio.data.form.usedOn`): the groups and order are used on the record page, the right-side preview, and the create and edit dialogs. No form view is read or written there, and there is no 新建/编辑 switch and no 「表单视图：…」 label.

- **Form-view code already deleted on main** before this PR, by the internal-forms retirement (3b5892155): `formViewSections.ts`, `useFormViewDraft.ts`, `formViewSections-30057.test.ts`, `DataPillar.formViewLayout-30057.test.tsx`, and the form-view branches of `ObjectFormDesigner.tsx` and `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`. Re-measured on this branch: no form-view read, write, label or switch is left in the tab.
- **Deleted here:** the 「字段分组」 chip (`data-testid="form-layout-source"`) and its two strings `engine.studio.data.form.layoutSource.fieldGroups` / `fieldGroupsTitle` (en, zh). `DataPillar.internalFormRetired-36425.test.tsx` now asserts the sentence in place of the chip.
- **Kept:** `ObjectFormDesigner` (now the Field layout canvas), the Layout/Preview switch, `ObjectGroupInspector`, `writeGroupLayout` / `readFieldGroupMembership`, and every canvas operation (item 5: add/rename/delete/move group, drag a field between groups, the keyboard drop, the pinned fields, group settings).

**The list spelling (item 2).** The canvas saves group membership in each group's own `fields` list through `writeGroupLayout`. New `groupListLayout` (object-fields-io.ts) reads an object still written in the older per-field `group` spelling into lists, so the object's first save from the tab converts it: every group lists its members in display order, and each field's `group` that a list now holds is dropped. Nothing on the canvas moves. The header sentence of `ObjectFormDesigner.tsx` that still named `fields[].group` + `fieldGroups` is rewritten.

**An installed object (item 3).** Where the base's customization door is open (`extendsBase && extWritable`, so `layoutWritable`), the tab is no longer read-only:

- Every canvas operation and the group inspector edit the object extension of the base's paired `.custom` package, in the Data pillar's extension buffer, as the whole `fieldGroups` arrangement (every non-table group listing its members, the format of #36498 / ADR-0146 D10). New `groupArrangement` builds it.
- The top bar's Save saves and publishes it with the rest of that extension (the `__c` fields and field patches it already holds stay). The original package is not written.
- A field-arrangement edit on a contributed field (a field another package brings) is allowed here, because the arrangement only places it. Its properties stay locked.
- A field or group `place` entry of the extension, which a written `fieldGroups` replaces (the server refuses the pair), is taken off by the new `withoutReplacedPlacements`. A `{list}` placement stays.
- `foldObjectExtension` now folds a buffered `fieldGroups` the way the registry does (`applyExtensionFieldGroups`), so the canvas shows the arrangement before it is saved. It also keeps a placed own field's served `group`.
- Each field card of an installed object carries its source: 「原始包」 / Original package, 「本环境」 / This environment (a field the pair declares, or any `__c` field), or the existing contributed mark that names the other package (`fieldLayoutSources.ts`).
- Where the door is walled, the tab stays read-only, as before.

**Write path, a deviation from the claim's wording.** The claim says to reuse the writer #36624 added (`saveObjectExtensionArrangement`). The tab uses that writer's composer `extensionWithArrangement` inside the pillar buffer instead of calling the save. The buffer already holds a draft of the very same `object_extension` document, so a second save would be a second writer of it: refused by the first-write pin while the buffer's draft is pending, and overwritten by the buffer's next save once it lands. The header of `objectExtensionArrangementSave.ts` now says so. No new write path: the bytes go out through the pillar's existing extension save and publish (`doSaveExt`).

**Not in this PR.**
- No public-forms UI is added or moved.
- The Interfaces pillar is not touched.
- `packages/spec` and the authorable surface are not touched (0 files under `packages/`).

**Overlap with #36784 (paused, public forms).** That PR's DataPillar hunks put a public-forms switch into this same tab. This PR keeps no switch, per the 2026-11-24 ruling (item 4: 字段布局 edits field groups only). `overlap-check` reports a textual conflict in `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`, plus shared lines in the studio string files and `access-security.json`. Whichever lands second rebases. Nothing here builds on it or copies it.

## Why

No console path could arrange an installed object's field groups: the record page's 「配置页面」 arranges tabs only, and this tab was walled read-only on an installed package. The tab's name 「表单」 also no longer matched what it edits since the internal-form retirement. It edits the field groups that the record page, the preview and both dialogs read.

## Tests

- New `object-fields-io.test.ts` cases:
  - `groupListLayout`: legacy to lists, mixed spelling, and unchanged when already listed (the same refs come back).
  - `groupArrangement`: the result safe-parses as an `ObjectExtensionSchema` body.
- New `StudioCustomizeControls.objectExtension-28575.test.ts` cases:
  - the buffered arrangement fold, with a CONTROL;
  - `withoutReplacedPlacements`;
  - a placed own field keeps its group.
- New `ObjectFormDesigner.test.tsx` cases:
  - a legacy object converts on a rename, with a CONTROL;
  - the field sources are marked on an installed object, with a CONTROL.
- New `DataPillar.baseObjectExtension-28575.test.tsx` describe, "the Field layout tab arranges an installed object into its pair":
  - The tab name, the sentence and the marks.
  - Deleting group `basic` saves the extension body `fieldGroups: [{ key: 'more', fields: ['industry', 'region__c'] }]`, keeps `fields` and `fieldPatches`, and leaves only the `{list}` placement. The body safe-parses. No object save; the publish goes to the pair.
  - A walled CONTROL.
- Updated tests:
  - `DataPillar.internalFormRetired-36425`: the sentence replaces the chip, and the save is in the list spelling.
  - `ObjectFormDesigner.keyboardDrop-11871` and `pinnedFields-27516`: the move pins read the first save's conversion.
  - `StudioDesignSurface.oneSurface-28572`: a base field is now an arrangeable card.
  - 25 files: the `{ name: 'Form' }` tab lookup now reads `{ name: 'Field layout' }`, and 8 of them get the module-top `@objectstack/lint` import that `check:test-source-alias` asks of edited files.
- **Ablation**, once, on the conversion (`groupListLayout` forced to answer unchanged, written by `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` with the anchor 1 → 0 and the blob 7d646795841f → 8ad709d6432e):
  - Result: 4 failed / 72 passed across `object-fields-io`, `ObjectFormDesigner` and `DataPillar.internalFormRetired-36425`.
  - Restored: `git diff HEAD` is empty, and the file blob equals the HEAD blob 7d646795841f.

## Acceptance notes

- **Group source marks are not drawn (a gap against item 3's "marks each source").** Field cards are marked. A group's source cannot be told on the client:
  - the served object carries no per-group source;
  - the layered `code` the canvas reads already has the pair folded in;
  - the customization contributions read lists fields only.
  
  Drawing group marks needs a read that serves who placed each group. That is a runtime read decoration (spec + runtime), raised in the report as a decision, not guessed here.
- **Reordering the ungrouped bucket on an installed object is not persisted.** An extension can arrange groups but cannot reorder the base's field map. The canvas snaps back when a drag produces nothing to save. Order inside a group is persisted (it is the group's list).
- **"Restore the original layout" has no button.** Removing `fieldGroups` from the pair's extension restores the base's groups. This was measured live through the API (below). A UI for it was not asked by the card's items.
- **Field/group `place` entries are dropped when the arrangement is written.** The server refuses them beside a written `fieldGroups` (`refusePlacementsTheArrangementReplaces`), and the arrangement states every group's members anyway.
- **The full `check:platform-checklist` is red on `main`, not from this diff.** `access-security.json` cites `packages/metadata-core/src/anonymous-form-intake.ts#anonymousFormExplicitWithdrawals`, a symbol that c45dd80ff9 (#36697) removed. Measured: the symbol has 0 hits in origin/main's file, and origin/main's checklist cites it twice. The scoped mode on this branch is OK: `check-platform-checklist --changed-from origin/main: OK — 2 anchored file(s) in the change set, 9 anchor(s) judged, 0 lost`.
- The live check used the showcase app's installed objects. HotCRM's 线索 is not in the example, so `showcase_category` stood in as the installed object.

- **Open questions decided (seat, 2026-11-24).** Group source marks are trimmed from this card: field cards are marked, groups are not (recorded on #36505 as 7125461985). The single-writer route is accepted: the tab composes `extensionWithArrangement` inside the Data pillar's buffer and saves through the pillar's extension Save, instead of calling `saveObjectExtensionArrangement`.
- **Fix round 1 (4b0d7ee635).** Step 3 of the live customize journey spec now clicks the object header's Field layout tab (it clicked Form). Run live on a booted showcase: 1 passed (25.2s). The Add field draft body is still exactly `{extend, fields}`.
- Open PR #36884 (#36502, Interfaces retirement) overlaps textually in `studio-authoring.json` and two StudioDesignSurface tests, plus shared files. Whichever lands second rebases.

## Screenshots (card 验收)

Taken at head 4b0d7ee635 on a booted showcase (`objectstack dev --seed-admin` plus console vite from this branch), browser locale zh-CN, 1440×900 at deviceScaleFactor 2. The files are in the project files under `issue-36505/`:

- `1-installed-field-layout.png`: the installed object `showcase_category` (com.example.showcase, badge 只读) on the 「字段布局」 tab. Groups are 分类 (名称, 上级) and 显示 (颜色, 排序). Every field card is marked 原始包, the sentence 「这里的分组和顺序用在记录页、右侧预览、新建和编辑弹窗上。」 is shown, and the group controls are enabled.
- `2-self-built-field-layout.png`: the self-built `qa_layout_ticket` (writable package com.example.qa-layout, authored in the legacy per-field `group` spelling) on the same tab, with groups Main (Title, Status) and Extra (Notes). It shows no source marks, no 只读 badge, and the same sentence. The package's own labels have no zh translation, so they stay in English.
- `3-installed-after-save.png`: `showcase_category` after 删除分组 on 显示 and the top-bar Save. The toast reads 「已保存并生效：分类」, and the groups are 分类 (名称, 上级) and 未分组 (颜色, 排序). The writes were `PUT /api/v1/meta/object_extension/showcase_category?mode=draft&package=com.example.showcase.custom` with body `{"extend":"showcase_category","fieldGroups":[{"key":"category","label":"Category","collapse":"none","fields":["name","parent"]}]}`, then publish at the pair (200). There was no write to `object/showcase_category`.

Customizations reading (card 验收, L1 N1): `GET /api/v1/packages/com.example.showcase/customizations`.
- Before the save: 200, `arrangements: []`, counts all 0.
- After the save: 200, `arrangements: [{"object":"showcase_category","key":"fieldGroups"}]`, `counts.arrangements: 1`, `counts.extensions: 0`. The pair's extension holds only the arrangement key.

## Verification

Two-minute check: boot the showcase with the console. Open Studio → Data → Category (installed, read-only package) → 字段布局 / Field layout, delete the group "Display", and press Save. The two fields fall to Ungrouped. `GET /api/v1/meta/object/showcase_category` serves one group `category` listing `name`, `parent`, and the base package is unchanged.

<details><summary>Live check on a booted showcase (head a144b62206), screenshots described</summary>

`objectstack dev --seed-admin -p 4517` with its own db, plus the console Vite dev server on :4518 pointed at it; Playwright Chromium, en-US.

- **Installed object** (`showcase_category`, package `com.example.showcase`, legacy per-field `group` spelling):
  - Screenshot 1: the tab strip reads Records · **Field layout** · Validations. The sentence sits beside Layout/Preview. Groups Category (Name, Parent) and Display (Color, Sort Order). Every card is marked 「Original package」. The group controls are enabled; the header badge still says Read-only (the package is).
  - Deleting Display and pressing Save sent exactly:
    - `POST /api/v1/packages/com.example.showcase/ensure-customization` → 201
    - `PUT /api/v1/meta/object_extension/showcase_category?mode=draft&package=com.example.showcase.custom` with body `{"extend":"showcase_category","fieldGroups":[{"key":"category","label":"Category","collapse":"none","fields":["name","parent"]}]}` → 200
    - `POST …/object_extension/showcase_category/publish?package=com.example.showcase.custom` → 200
    - No write to `object/showcase_category`.
  - Screenshot 2: Category (Name, Parent) and Ungrouped (Color, Sort Order).
  - Served object afterwards: `fieldGroups: [category → name, parent]`; `color` and `sort_order` carry no group.
  - Revert by API: the extension saved without `fieldGroups` and published (200/200) serves the base's two groups again, with `color` / `sort_order` → `display`.
- **Self-built object** (`qa_layout_ticket` in a scratch writable package `com.example.qa-layout`, authored in the legacy spelling: `title`/`status` → `main`, `notes` → `extra`):
  - Screenshot 3: groups Main and Extra, no source marks (not an installed object).
  - Deleting Extra and pressing Save sent one `PUT /api/v1/meta/object/qa_layout_ticket?mode=draft&package=com.example.qa-layout` whose body has `fieldGroups: [{"key":"main","label":"Main","fields":["title","status"]}]` and no `group` on any field (the first-save conversion), then the publish → 200.
  - Screenshot 4: Main (Title, Status) and Ungrouped (Notes).

</details>
